findings.title: Missing security header: Strict-Transport-Security
findings.description: The Strict-Transport-Security response header was not present on 127.0.0.1.
findings.why_it_matters: HSTS tells browsers to only connect over HTTPS for a set period, protecting users from protocol-downgrade and cookie-hijacking attacks.
evidence: Header not present in the HTTP response
findings.recommendation: Set Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains on every HTTPS response.

findings.title: Missing security header: Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: The Content-Security-Policy response header was not present on 127.0.0.1.
findings.why_it_matters: CSP restricts which resources a page may load, sharply reducing the impact of cross-site scripting (XSS) and injection attacks.
evidence: Header not present in the HTTP response
findings.recommendation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header with explicit source allowlists (start with default-src 'self' and tighten over time).

findings.title: Missing security header: X-Frame-Options
findings.description: The X-Frame-Options response header was not present on 127.0.0.1.
findings.why_it_matters: Without clickjacking protection an attacker can embed the page in a transparent iframe and trick users into unintended actions.
evidence: Header not present in the HTTP response
findings.recommendation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN if framing by same-origin pages is required).

findings.title: Missing security header: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: The X-Content-Type-Options response header was not present on 127.0.0.1.
findings.why_it_matters: Without nosniff, browsers may guess the MIME type of a response, which can turn an upload into an executable script.
evidence: Header not present in the HTTP response
findings.recommendation: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses.

findings.title: Missing security header: Referrer-Policy
findings.description: The Referrer-Policy response header was not present on 127.0.0.1.
findings.why_it_matters: Referrer-Policy controls how much of the previous URL is leaked to other sites, protecting sensitive query strings and paths.
evidence: Header not present in the HTTP response
findings.recommendation: Set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or no-referrer for highly sensitive applications).

findings.title: Missing security header: Permissions-Policy
findings.description: The Permissions-Policy response header was not present on 127.0.0.1.
findings.why_it_matters: Permissions-Policy restricts which browser features (camera, microphone, geolocation) a page and its frames may use.
evidence: Header not present in the HTTP response
findings.recommendation: Set Permissions-Policy with a restrictive default, e.g. Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=().

findings.title: Missing security header: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy
findings.description: The Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy response header was not present on 127.0.0.1.
findings.why_it_matters: CORP stops other origins from loading this site's resources, reducing cross-origin data leakage.
evidence: Header not present in the HTTP response
findings.recommendation: Set Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin unless cross-origin embedding is explicitly required.

findings.title: Web server software disclosed (with version)
findings.description: The server disclosed its software via the Server header: 'Python/3.11.9'.
findings.why_it_matters: Version numbers help attackers identify known vulnerabilities. Even without a version, the software name narrows the attack surface.
findings.recommendation: Remove the 'Server' response header (or disable the framework option that adds it) to reduce information disclosure.

findings.title: Verbose error message / stack trace exposed
findings.description: GET /error returned HTTP 500 with a stack trace or debug output in the response body.
findings.why_it_matters: Stack traces reveal internal implementation details, file paths, and sometimes secrets, aiding targeted attacks.
findings.recommendation: Configure the application to return generic error pages without stack traces in production.

findings.title: HTTPS not available
findings.description: Could not establish a TLS connection to 127.0.0.1:8012: [SSL: WRONG_VERSION_NUMBER] wrong version number (_ssl.c:1006)
findings.why_it_matters: Without HTTPS, all traffic — including credentials — is transmitted in plaintext.
findings.recommendation: Enable TLS on the server and redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS.
